purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Official Ujjain pages route land-record service to MP Bhulekh and identify Lok Seva Kendra coverage. The public Ujjain GIS service has urban planning and base layers but no cadastral parcel layer. The official land-record portal is a login/record workflow; no property lookup or public parcel geometry was used.
registryAssessment: The official Ujjain District land-records page routes to Madhya Pradesh Bhulekh and lists Lok Seva Kendra service locations including Ujjain. The official Hindi route confirms the same. The district GIS page describes infrastructure and land-use layers, while its published map service contains planning/base layers, not cadastral parcel records. Registry access exists through state records, but no public safe parcel geometry was verified at the exact urban locator.
